title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Minimum Hours Standing on a Dispatched Call
content:
Where the call record puts the hours outside regular hours and the hours logged fall short of the tier's
after-hours minimum, the after-hours minimum stands as the hours charged for. Where the call record puts
the hours in regular hours and the hours logged fall short of the tier's minimum billable hours, the
tier's minimum billable hours stand as the hours charged for. In any other case no minimum stands in
place of the hours the ticket logs.

The two minimums by program under the Demand Service Rate Programs:

| Program | Minimum billable hours (regular hours) | After-hours minimum hours |
|---|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 2 | 4 |
| Priority Response Program | 2 | 4 |
| Block Hour Service Program | 1.5 | 3 |
| Emergency Response Program | 1.5 | 2 |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 1 | 2 |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 1 | 2 |

### The two conditions in combination

| The band the call record puts the hours in | The hours logged against that program's figure | The hours charged for |
|---|---|---|
| outside regular hours | short of the after-hours minimum | the after-hours minimum |
| outside regular hours | at or above the after-hours minimum | the hours logged, no minimum standing in their place |
| regular hours | short of the minimum billable hours | the minimum billable hours |
| regular hours | at or above the minimum billable hours | the hours logged, no minimum standing in their place |

### Both sides of the figures (hypothetical)

On the Block Hour Service Program, whose minimum billable hours are 1.5 and whose after-hours minimum is
3.0: a call the record puts in regular hours logging 1.4 hours is charged for 1.5 hours, while one
logging 1.5 hours falls short of nothing and stands at its logged hours. A call the record puts outside
regular hours logging 2.9 hours is charged for 3.0 hours; one logging 3.0 hours stands at its logged
hours.
